title: FACET Data Entity Record
description: Schema for a FACET data-entity record (FACET specification, Appendix A.4).

id.description: Canonical data-entity ID in the form data/<domain>/<entity> (lowercase kebab-case).

fields.description: Ordered list of fields in this data entity.

version.description: Schema version string (e.g. 'v1', '2.0.0', '2024-01-15'). Used to track schema evolution.

policy.description: Human-readable description of the retention policy for this entity (e.g. 'Delete on account erasure request', 'Retain for 7 years per financial regulations').

duration.description: Maximum retention duration expressed as an ISO 8601 duration or human-readable string (e.g. 'P7Y', '90d', 'indefinite').

team.description: Team that owns this data entity and is responsible for its schema, migrations, and retention enforcement.

read_by.description: Feature IDs (domain/capability/feature) or team names that read this entity.

mutated_by.description: Feature IDs (domain/capability/feature) or team names that create, update, or delete records of this entity.

name.description: Field name as it appears in the canonical data model.

constraints.description: Validation or database constraints applied to this field (e.g. 'not-null', 'unique', 'max-length:255', 'encrypted-at-rest').

references.description: If this field is a foreign key or logical reference, the data-entity ID it points to (e.g. 'data/crm/customer-account').
